- Added ambient pixel motes, a scene glint, and a route-target marker.

- Make text more readable.

- Increase the camera zoom a little further.
- Improve text readability and adjust the mobile layout for portrait and landscape.

- (none)

- `game.js`: canvas camera scaling and game rendering.
- `style.css`: responsive layout and mobile UI styles.
- `index.html`: canvas, status bar, and mobile controls structure.

- Changes are uncommitted. `Agents.md` also has a pre-existing modification; leave it untouched.
